Summary
: The English translation of the Mahabhagavata Purana including an introduction and study. Another name for this text is the Devi Purana and it represents an ancient Sanskrit text comprising 81 chapters and belonging to the Shaktism tradition (worship of the Goddess). The Shakti cult, focusing on the worship of the female principle, is a significant and very ancient aspect of Hinduism. Several texts, like the Devi Purana and Kalika Purana, celebrate the mother goddess.
